text: どの　ポケモンに　おしえたい　かい？

structure.en: do you want to teach it?

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb means 'want to do'. おしえたい = 'want to teach'.

patterns.name: 〜かい
patterns.explanation: かい at the end is a soft, friendly way of asking a question, used mostly by older men. おしえたい かい = 'do you want to teach it?'.
